{'index': 0, 'translation': 'Apple is about to launch a new version of the iPad mini. This will be the first update to the device in two years, and is expected to be a major upgrade. Here is everything we currently know about the upcoming new iPad mini, set to debut next month.'}

{'index': 1, 'translation': 'OLED Display'}

{'index': 2, 'translation': 'The biggest change in the new iPad mini to date will be the display. According to multiple sources, the iPad mini 8 will feature an OLED display.'}

{'index': 3, 'translation': "This will be a significant upgrade over the iPad mini's current LCD panel. For users, switching to OLED means deeper blacks, richer colours, and better contrast. The iPhone X was Apple's first iPhone to adopt an OLED display in 2017, while the iPad Pro with OLED made its debut in 2024."}

{'index': 4, 'translation': 'However, one question remains unresolved: whether the new iPad mini will feature a ProMotion display supporting refresh rates of up to 120Hz. According to an unconfirmed rumour last week, the new iPad mini will not offer ProMotion support, and will only support a 60Hz refresh rate.'}

{'index': 5, 'translation': 'However, this rumour has not been confirmed by other sources, so I am still hoping the news is wrong.'}

{'index': 6, 'translation': 'New Chip'}

{'index': 7, 'translation': "The current iPad mini, launched in October 2024, features Apple's A17 Pro chip. The new iPad mini is expected to adopt the A19 Pro or A20 Pro chip, which will bring significant performance improvements and may support the most advanced Siri AI features in iOS 27."}

{'index': 8, 'translation': 'Better Water Resistance'}

{'index': 9, 'translation': 'According to Bloomberg, Apple has tested a "redesigned casing" for the iPad mini with water resistance comparable to the iPhone.'}

{'index': 10, 'translation': 'Whether this water-resistant casing ultimately makes it into production remains unknown, but it would make the iPad mini more durable. This is particularly important for users who use the iPad mini as an e-reader, since water resistance is one of the major selling points of dedicated e-readers like the Kindle.'}

{'index': 11, 'translation': 'New Speaker Technology'}

{'index': 12, 'translation': 'The iPad mini 8 may also become the first device from Apple to adopt an entirely new vibration-based speaker system. This vibration-based speaker system would allow Apple to remove speaker grilles, helping achieve the goal of making the device water-resistant.'}

{'index': 13, 'translation': 'By comparison, while the iPhone does have speaker grilles, Apple achieves water resistance by using rubber gaskets and adhesives.'}

{'index': 14, 'translation': 'New iPad mini Release Date'}

{'index': 15, 'translation': 'According to the latest Bloomberg report, Apple is aiming to launch the iPad mini with OLED as early as October this year. This is said to be "the biggest overhaul of the iPad mini in five years."'}

{'index': 16, 'translation': 'As for the price of the new iPad mini, there is no conclusion yet. In July, Apple raised the price of the current iPad mini from US$499 to US$599 (currently on sale at Amazon for US$569). Whether the new iPad mini with OLED will be even more expensive remains to be seen.'}

{'index': 17, 'translation': 'What are your thoughts on the iPad mini rumours from Apple? Does the OLED display appeal to you? Feel free to share your opinions in the comments section.'}
